method.baseline: Use the frozen same-domain paired assessment and require its exact source hashes and target rosters.
method.candidate: Keep all existing readings. If a draft is outside the current scope, map separate sentences between globally unique pairs of unchanged neighbors within their respective paragraphs. Refuse reordered or overlapping neighborhoods. Diff only within each mapped sentence.
method.rules: On the additional regions compare the existing both-check context odds rule with the historical two-scale rule. Each arm retains every incumbent outcome. Count exact labeled sentences and distinct flagged ordinary works. Wrong and unmatched locations remain in the denominator.
method.adoption: Only trial an arm locally with at least six added exact edits across three held works and both generators, at most two additional ordinary works, and no more than two other highlighted locations whose authorship is unassigned. Adopt at most one arm, preferring the one with more additional exact edits then lower ordinary and unknown flags.
